q: Do the channel numbers add up to the September total you gave me?
answer:
By order date on a P&L basis, the finance-channel rows do add up to the September net sales total: they sum to ₹15,74,765, the same month total I gave you.

- Biggest channel: Meta — ₹9,36,516 (59.5% of September net sales).
- Others: Google ₹4,48,030 (28.5%), Unattributed ₹1,46,638 (9.3%), WhatsApp ₹37,783 (2.4%), Organic ₹5,798 (0.4%).
- Why it matters: Meta delivered the majority of P&L net sales in September; focusing the campaign-level profitability check there will cover most of the sales impact.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-29 · Data basis: by order date (P&L net sales)
